competitive_landscape: Access today is by diesel ferry from Mersing or Tanjung Gemok (seasonal, monsoon-closed Nov–Feb) or by small plane. There is no direct fast link from Singapore and no zero-emission option to the marine park.

demand_signals.label: Singapore outbound leisure
demand_signals.note: Premium long-range leisure corridor from a wealthy hub

journeys.today: Drive ~4 h to Mersing then a diesel ferry — a full day each way, closed in monsoon.
journeys.with_navier: A single Quanta-LR hybrid leg direct from Singapore (H2 2026+) — a clean, fast, all-water connection.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Short in-island and Mersing ↔ Tioman hops are within Pioneer II range for a near-term all-electric tier.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: The ~108.6nm Singapore ↔ Tioman corridor is a Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) flagship — a 12-waypoint water-routed arc threading the eastern channel, beyond Pioneer II range and held out of the near-term floor per null-beats-guess.

precedents.why_it_matters: Evidence of Navier's SEA momentum — a regional anchor for a Singapore-outbound corridor.

regulatory_note: Tioman sits within a gazetted Malaysian marine park; cross-border Singapore–Malaysia operation requires ICQS/maritime coordination both ends. Zero-wake, zero-emission foiling suits the protected reef waters. Engagement via Marine Department Malaysia and Singapore MPA.
seasonality: Northeast monsoon (Nov–Feb) closes the conventional ferries and roughens the crossing; Mar–Oct is the operating window. The Quanta-LR's range and the foiling ride extend the practical season.
summary: Tioman is a forested marine-park island off Peninsular Malaysia's east coast, a diving and resort destination historically reached via Mersing/Tanjung Gemok. The flagship roadmap corridor is the long open-water leg from Singapore (Tanah Merah) — a Quanta-LR hybrid range play.
tagline: A duty-free marine-park island off Malaysia's east coast — the long Quanta-LR roadmap leg from Singapore.

use_cases.body: A single Quanta-LR hybrid leg turning a full-day mainland-ferry journey into a direct premium water connection.
